concerns.text: Duplicate identifier 'SC-001' is used both for a System Constraint (CPU Tractability) and again in the Success Criteria placeholder table. IDs must be unique across the entire spec.

AC-003 requires anxiety scores for ≥95% of valid rows, while AC-004 excludes low‑confidence predictions (threshold < 0.6). If many predictions are low‑confidence, the ≥95% coverage may be impossible, creating a contradictory requirement.
